Dialog retrieval tasks often use recall out of k (R x @k) as a key metric, measuring out of x candidates how often the answer is in top-k. In this paper, we focus on the top-1 accuracy R x @1 (R x for short) with a candidate set size of x, where x ∈ {2, 5, 10, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100}. The recall metric is modified for uncertainty measurement purposes, and is further extended to calculate the NOTA accuracy out of x (N x ), and F1 scores for each class (N F 1 x , GF 1 x ).
